service: background-service

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ap-south-1
  timeout: 30
  environment:
    VIDEO_UPLOAD_QUEUE_URL: !Ref VideoUploadQueue
    COURSE_INTRO_VIDEO_QUEUE_URL: !Ref CourseIntroVideoUploadQueue
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: !GetAtt VideoUploadQueue.Arn
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: !GetAtt CourseIntroVideoUploadQueue.Arn
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: !GetAtt ChatNotificationQueue.Arn

plugins:
  - serverless-offline

custom:
  serverless-offline:
    httpPort: 3002
    lambdaPort: 3003

resources:
  Resources:
    VideoUploadQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: video-upload-queue
        VisibilityTimeout: 300

    CourseIntroVideoUploadQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: course-intro-video-upload-queue
        VisibilityTimeout: 300

    ChatNotificationQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: chat-notification-queue
        VisibilityTimeout: 300

functions:



  # ── HTTP Endpoints ─────────────────────────────────────────

  createVideoUploadProgress:
    handler: src/functions/video/processVideoUpload.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /video/create-upload-progress
          method: post
          


  # ── SQS Background Jobs ──────────────────────────────────────

  processVideoUpload:
    handler: src/functions/video/processVideoUpload.handler
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt VideoUploadQueue.Arn
          batchSize: 1

  courseIntroVideoUpload:
    handler: src/functions/video/courseIntroVideoUpload.handler
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt CourseIntroVideoUploadQueue.Arn
          batchSize: 1


  chatNotificationWorker:
    handler: src/functions/chat/chat.notification.handler
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt ChatNotificationQueue.Arn
          batchSize: 1


  # ── cron Jobs ──────────────────────────────────────

  syncVideoProgress:
    handler: src/functions/video/syncVideoProgress.handler
    events:
      - schedule:
          rate: rate(5 minutes)
          enabled: false



  # ── Webhooks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  tpstreamsWebhook:
    handler: src/functions/webhooks/tpstreamsWebhook.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /webhooks/tpstreams
          method: post
          # No auth — TPStreams calls this directly
